readingScope: All text pages read; selected visual pages 7, 8, 21 and 51 inspected. Closing and appendix pages are not additional teaching objectives.
teaching: Nine original lessons: evidence/models; orbitals/probability; quantum numbers; configurations; transition ions; periodic organisation; radius; ionisation energies; electron addition/electronegativity.
questions: 34 original candidates; independent numeric/key checks and stable question-to-actual-section links. Foundational, distinction, calculation and application cases; no official past-paper claim.

corrections.decision: Use standard names; do not make spelling an assessment objective.

corrections.issue: Position conflated with wavelength; orbital defined as a sharp 95% volume
corrections.decision: Distinguish position/momentum/wavelength; use |psi| squared and conventional probability boundaries.

corrections.issue: Spin described as literal rotation; range of ms could imply continuous values
corrections.decision: Intrinsic spin with two projections; apply ml range to the selected l.

corrections.issue: All cations described as noble-gas-like; close 3d/4s energies oversimplified
corrections.decision: NIST Cr/Cu exceptions; remove 4s before 3d for common transition cations. Fe2+/Fe3+ retain d electrons.
Use modern 18 groups, older notation qualification, C/Si group 14, helium exception and strict d-block/transition distinction.

corrections.issue: Effective charge described as one proton; radius conventions mixed; anion trends reversed
corrections.decision: Net attraction after shielding; comparable radius definitions; anions generally larger down a group and isoelectronic contraction with increasing Z.

corrections.issue: Single atom/molar energy language and affinity signs/trend arrows require scope
corrections.decision: Explicit gaseous species and energy-change sign convention; exceptions and distinct electronegativity scale. Exact francium minimum not assessed.

supplementaryExamples: 500 nm photon calculation with supplied constants
Illustrative successive-ionisation series; not a uniquely identifying measured dataset
Oxygen energy sum uses explicitly supplied rounded lecturer values, not a precision claim
limitations: Selected diagrams inspected, not every external visual/reference
Isolated-atom configurations and radii do not alone predict protein-bound metal chemistry or hydrated channel selectivity
Source topic representation is draft coverage, not certified examination completeness
